title: Baked Drumsticks with Honey Amber Glaze
description: Crispy fried drumsticks coated in a sweet honey amber glaze, perfect for a family dinner.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together buttermilk, honey, amber, paprika, garlic powder, salt, and pepper. Add chicken drumsticks and marinate for at least 30 minutes.
In a separate bowl, mix flour. Remove drumsticks from buttermilk mixture and coat in flour, shaking off excess.
Heat about 1/2-inch (1 cm) of vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Fry drumsticks in batches until golden brown and crispy, about 5-6 minutes per side.
Transfer drumsticks to a baking sheet lined with parchment paper. Bake for an additional 15-20 minutes, or until cooked through.
Let drumsticks rest for a few minutes before serving.
